business_problem: Fanatics Betting and Gaming needed to reduce manual finance work so its team could spend less time collecting information and more time on strategy, decision-making, and higher-impact operational planning.
solution_summary: Fanatics Betting and Gaming built a structured ChatGPT adoption program inside finance so AI could automate repetitive work instead of remaining a one-off experiment. The team formed an AI automation task force, gathered process ideas from staff, trained every finance team member on ChatGPT, and ran a GPT-athon with data scientists to build custom GPTs around specific workflow opportunities. One result is VendorID GPT, which automates vendor identification and contract summarization, while other uses focus on faster data analysis, cohort analysis, trend plotting, and closing-the-books work. Operational inputs such as vendor documents, contracts, and financial datasets flow into ChatGPT or specialized GPTs, and the resulting summaries and insights are used directly by the finance team and the CFO. That combination of enablement plus workflow-specific assistants turns ChatGPT into a daily finance partner rather than an ad hoc productivity tool.
